g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-212 Bin screw feeder (built in house, 9 off) · rev B
Product contact: ID Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin] (A270 S2 tube); welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
END FLANGE FACE: machine after welding
⟂ 0.1 to A; recess Ø70 H8 x 3 coaxial Ø0.1 to A

svg.text: VIEW F (1:1): END FLANGE AFTER MACHINING

g.text: Ø60.2 [2.370] THRU (= tube ID, blend flush)

svg.text: WELD SCHEDULE (AWS D18.1 / ASME BPE MJ; weld log per joint)
fuse root, grind flush to ID
fillet 2 outside all round; flange flat 0.3
full pen., ID flush, no concavity > 0.1
A270 316L 2.5 in x 16 ga, saddle cut
1. Weld the transition (W2) as a box first, then W3 to the tube with the slot cut; then the inlet flange (W4) square to the tube axis within 0.5 over
2. Weld W1 and W6 with the tube clamped in V-blocks; straightness of the finished barrel 0.5 [.02] over its length (checked with the screw: it must turn
3. Machine the end flange outer face, Ø70 H8 recess and M6 holes AFTER all welding, set up on the barrel axis (datum A from the tube OD at both ends).
4. Pickle and passivate the whole weldment (ASTM A967 nitric 2) after machining; rinse with RO water; inspect the ID with a borescope (ITP T3).
